message: 傍観より諦観で

name: Nanaka
message: 「Agh, I'm so busy! Agh, I'm so busy!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Haste makes waste, you know, Madam Treasurer.」

name: Misa
message: 「You could at least try pretending to be busy, Lolotte.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh, I see! That is a brilliant idea.」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte, put together a list of these pending issues for me.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Now then, next up is--」

name: Ria
message: 「Here you go, some tea ♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, thank you very much.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「*Sip, sip*... Haaa--that hits the spot!」
The Student Council room was in a frantic rush with KiraFes preparations.
Even though Ria-senpai had her own work to do, she still looked out for everyone like this and served us tea.
So this is the kind of thoughtfulness you'd expect from a true president. I need to become more attentive to the people around me, too.

name: Synn
message: 「Alright! Then have some milk while you're at it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't need it!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Matcha milk...」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Misa
message: 「Thank you for calling. Ryuusei Student Council--」

name: Misa
message: 「What!? A Demon!?」
Despite the report, the shopping district was bustling peacefully as usual.

name: Lolotte
message: 「To show up at a busy time like this--what an utterly cowardly Demon!!」

name: Synn
message: 「You sure seem pumped up for someone complaining about it.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This too is the power of justice at work.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, where's the Demon that we're actually looking for?」

name: Misa
message: 「I heard it's at a secondhand bookstore around here.」

name: Ria
message: 「A demon doing bad things in a bookstore...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... I bet they're reading dirty books or something」

name: Synn
message: 「Wha--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hoho~. So by 'dirty books,' you mean perverted books, correct?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Lolo-chan. That's literally the exact same thing\s01」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's what you'd call a man's romance. Right, Lord Synn?」

name: Synn
message: 「Stop with the obvious setups!」

name: Synn
message: 「I knew it!」

name: Misa
message: 「It's just as my sister says. Honestly, boys are so lewd and filthy」

name: Synn
message: 「I haven't even said anything yet!」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun, I understand that you're interested in that kind of thing, too, but...」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, well... if you're a healthy boy, it can't be helped... right?\s03」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah! That's right!」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey~ now, don't get carried away!\s09」

name: Synn
message: 「What a terrible false accusation...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Shall I just go ahead and drench you soaking wet, body and soul?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And then I'll dry you right up in an instant\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「What a picture of hell!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... The nuisance is gone. Now, Ria―chan's heart belongs to yours truly―」

name: Paqy
message: 「Oh」

name: Paqy
message: 「Zueeeeeeh!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's your own fault to begin with」

name: Ria
message: 「Bad!」
He had sized things up properly.
Looking over at the shop that had been reported―the secondhand bookstore "Kindai Kosho"―a Demon was sitting right at the entrance.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Blocking the entrance? Interfering with business?」

name: Ria
message: 「No. It looks like they're letting customers in just fine」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And neither side seems bothered by the other at all, do they」
There is no sign of it causing any overt trouble.

name: Misa
message: 「You'd think they wouldn't go out of their way to read a book in a place like this」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey there. What are you doing here?」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn, honestly!!」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Whoa~~!」
My arm is grabbed and I'm pulled back.

name: Ria
message: 「It's dangerous to walk up so carelessly! You don't know what it might do……」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not going to do anything」

name: Ria
message: 「You can't let your guard down~!」

name: Synn
message: 「If anything, it's the one completely wide open. Besides, it's not getting in anyone's way」

name: Synn
message: 「And besides, suddenly pointing a weapon and yelling 'Freeze!' just isn't something I could ever……」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It really wouldn't suit you~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, forcing yourself isn't good!」

name: Misa
message: 「You shouldn't say things that are completely out of character」

name: Synn
message: 「You're all so mean!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, no, it's true I was careless, so…… sorry for making you worry」

name: Ria
message: 「No. You might be right, Synn. I'm the one who should be sorry」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And so, the two of them safely made up~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey!! What are you saying!!」

name: Misa
message: 「No way, that's unacceptable!! Their relationship ends right here!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「It hasn't even started in the first place!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Geez! Everyone's just saying whatever they want~~!!」
Left completely alone, the demon is engrossed in reading without paying us any mind.

name: Synn
message: 「So. About what you were saying earlier... mind letting us hear the rest?」

name: Jirou
message: 「Eee」
From what I hear, there aren't any decent books in the Demon World.

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see... So it really is nothing but dirty books!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Enough about that already!!」
Not satisfied with just the imports obtained through Demon World Mail-Order, he apparently came all the way to the Human World like this.

name: Synn
message: 「And because he doesn't have any money, he's standing around reading for free」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No wonder. I thought he was awfully quiet, so that's what's going on」

name: Ria
message: 「So the one who called it in was the shop owner, huh」

name: Misa
message: 「If it's just browsing without buying, there are plenty of others doing that too」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Everyone, please look closely. He is sitting down quite properly, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「S-So that's how it is~」
Not standing and reading, but sitting and reading.

name: Ria
message: 「I wonder how long he's been here~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That is obvious at a single glance at the snow piled atop his head!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No. It's not even snowing」

name: Jirou
message: 「Eee」

name: Synn
message: 「Since opening? Well, that's... A short while is one thing, but if you stick around that long, of course you're gonna get yelled at」
Moreover, it wasn't just today--apparently he was here yesterday and the day before that, too.

name: Misa
message: 「So the owner finally lost patience, is that it」

name: Ria
message: 「If he just had money, there wouldn't be a problem, though...」

name: Synn
message: 「Money, huh...」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, you. Do you happen to have any books you're already tired of reading?」
I borrow one of his books.

name: Misa
message: 「What is this, I can't read a word of it」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What terrible handwriting~」

name: Jirou
message: 「Eee!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Easy now. If you let every little thing Lolo-chan says get to you, you lose」
My ear gets tugged hard repeatedly.

name: Paqy
message: 「Whoa, hold on. Isn't this an out-of-print specialist book on Three-Realm Topology?」

name: Synn
message: 「You know about it?」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's an absolute gem that experts in that field would die for」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmph~~. I don't really get it, but it sounds expensive」

name: Paqy
message: 「Yeah. If someone in the Human World wanted this, it might fetch a pretty high price...」

name: Synn
message: 「We might not be able to barter this book―not quite, anyway―but we might be able to sell it」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, I see!」

name: Synn
message: 「This is a secondhand bookstore, after all. If you sell the book you have here, you'll get money for it. And if you use that money, you'll be able to buy the new books you wanted to read」

name: Synn
message: 「If you want, I can go talk to the shopkeeper...」

name: Jirou
message: 「Eee!」
I got an immediate okay.

name: Ria
message: 「Well then, shall we go talk to the shopkeeper?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, while I'm at it, I might as well bring up KiraFes too」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Amazing... To think it'd sell for this much...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh! How much did you get?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hideyo-senseiiiiii!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yes, thank you for that completely predictable reaction. So, looks like he can buy the books he's after?」
Apparently, he wants to buy outdated gossip books. Since they're a flat 50 yen each, he can stretch it up to 20 volumes.

name: Ria
message: 「Good for you\s04」

name: Jirou
message: 「Eee♪」
And so, without ever trading blows with the demon, the incident was resolved effortlessly.

name: Ria
message: 「To think he loves reading... Demons really come in all types, don't they~」

name: Synn
message: 「There weren't any until now?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah... So I end up getting on guard out of habit\s01」
From the perspective of a senior who has been fighting demons all this time, my actions must seem incomprehensible.
Because I know there are demons like Paqy, I don't get worked up over every little thing.
Even if I don't really feel like it, I'm a demon myself, after all.

name: Ria
message: 「Still, what surprised me most was today's judgment」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Ria
message: 「Up until now, it always turned into a fight. They wouldn't listen to a single word I said」

name: Ria
message: 「I thought all demons were just like that. Maybe I'd given up」

name: Ria
message: 「And yet, today the demon actually listened. You settled things without a fight, Synn-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「Do you think it would've been better if I'd properly driven them back to the Demon World...」

name: Ria
message: 「No, not at all! Even I... honestly think getting them to agree peacefully like this is for the best」

name: Ria
message: 「It's just that if we let them do whatever they want, a lot of people end up in trouble, so...」
In battles against demons, Ria-senpai almost always carries herself with a dignified sense of tension.
It's such a drastic change that you couldn't imagine it from the gentle, heartwarming expression she usually shows.
That just goes to show how seriously she takes her duties as a Crusader.

name: Ria
message: 「I didn't know any way to resolve things other than force. But you taught me how, Synn-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, um... I just figured if I kept at it patiently and didn't give up, things might work out...」

name: Ria
message: 「You really are amazing, Synn-kun」

name: Synn
message: 「A... Thank you very much\s03」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Stop grinning like an idiot! It was just a fluke!!」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I can play the part of a negotiator too, you know!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're both being unsightly」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, hoping we can resolve things peacefully like this next time too」

name: Misa
message: 「Still, it's creepy seeing a demon become this obedient」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Didn't you use hypnosis or something on them?」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't say things that make me sound shady」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah, I've figured it out!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President is definitely the king of the Demons!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Obeying what the king says is just a natural rule, you know.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn, a king?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「When you think of a king, they're all dressed up with a crown like on a playing card, with a mustache and...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aha, ta-hahaha!」

name: Misa
message: 「It's rude to laugh, Nanaka... pfft, heehee. Ending his sentences with 'forsooth' or something... heehee.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, hold on. Demons do whatever the hell they want, right? Just 'cause he's the Demon King doesn't mean they'll listen to him.」

name: Ria
message: 「True. If they did, there wouldn't be any point to us Crusaders.」
Nice save, Paqy! Though I don't think a king would say 'forsooth.'

name: Nanaka
message: 「Man, sorry, sorry. Once I pictured it, I couldn't stop. Well, Student Council President suits Synn best anyway.」

name: Misa
message: 「I'll gift you the title of 'Vice' as your crown.」

name: Synn
message: 「No thanks, I'll pass.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Still, it really does bother me~ Demons have such a strong image of being arrogant and unruly, after all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The one today wasn't aggressive or rowdy, and didn't have any motivation at all.」

name: Synn
message: 「Maybe it didn't have the will to fight in the first place.」

name: Paqy
message: 「More like it didn't even have the strength to fight, don't ya think?」

name: Misa
message: 「Paqy. What do you mean by that...?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Even a Demon that pathetically weak is able to make its way over to the Human World now.」

name: Ria
message: 「A Demon with no magic power appearing is something that's never happened before!」

name: Synn
message: 「An abnormal situation. The possibility of the impossible happening...」

name: Ria
message: 「Even for a Demon with huge amounts of magic power, coming to the Human World is supposed to be super hard. And yet...」

name: Synn
message: 「If they can come to the Human World even without magic power, a huge number of Demons might come flooding in!」
Have things fallen into a more serious state than we thought...?

name: Ria
message: 「This really is the influence of Re-Crea too...」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm... Maybe I have to do something about this?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why are you phrasing it like a question?」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey now. At a time like that, you're supposed to say something like, 'Leave it to me, I'll handle it!'」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that how it works」

name: Ria
message: 「That's right. Because that's what the leader of the Ryuusei Student Council and the Crusaders is all about」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. So that's how it is... A-All right!」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'll handle this!」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, yeah. That's the spirit, that's the spirit」
She played me like a fiddle.

name: Ria
message: 「Now then! Shall we head back and continue」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah. Things wrapped up faster than expected, too」

name: Misa
message: 「If it was going to be like this, Sakura-kun should have just gone alone」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're all quite useless, aren't you」

name: Paqy
message: 「Same goes for you」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hau!」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun is today's MVP. You even properly promoted the KiraFes, too」

name: Synn
message: 「It seemed like we could hold a used book fair or something there」

name: Ria
message: 「Congrats~~. Good for you♪ Well then, time for the usual\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, aah!? Senpai, not there--」
She suddenly shoves her hand into my pocket and starts rummaging around.

name: Ria
message: 「Hey now, don't be shy」

name: Synn
message: 「No, even if you say that--ah, aah...! Not there, stop!」
On top of that, her chest is pressing against my hip.

name: Ria
message: 「Found it~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Haa, haa...」
I'm glad I didn't put it in my pants pocket.

name: Ria
message: 「All done, you worked really hard♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you very much……」
The fact that he even gropes people's bodies unconsciously is a real problem.

name: Ria
message: 「It's filled up quite a bit, hasn't it. Just a little more to go, so keep it up」

name: Synn
message: 「Y……Yes!」
If even a fraction of that sparkling school life comes true when this is completely filled, it'll be worth celebrating.
